summary: The track work itself meets spec.md: the audit goes from 0 critical / 4 high / 6 moderate / 1 low to five zero counts, no advisory remains, the AC3 gate after sets equal the before sets, the AC4 builds and render pass, and AC5 holds with the push pending by design. Fresh spot-checks at HEAD 5d74968c pass: the audit gate exits 0 with five zero counts, a direct pnpm audit finds no known vulnerability, and the two audit-gate suites pass 30 of 30. Final acceptance fails on one closeout-readiness blocker only: bash measure/doctor.sh exits 1 with three errors that name this track or its facts (missing index.md, metadata status new against three complete tasks, stale generated status), and node measure/tools/generate.mjs --check exits 1 on the same stale fact. The closeout standard requires doctor exit 0. The fix is orchestrator bookkeeping, not implementation work.
blocking_findings: FA-1 [Blocker] final-acceptance: `bash measure/doctor.sh` exits 1 with three errors: (1) `measure/tracks/chore_dependency_refresh_20261121/index.md: missing required track file` (the folder never held index.md, at track base 113b6c28 or at HEAD); (2) `measure/tracks/chore_dependency_refresh_20261121/plan.md: new track has started tasks` (metadata.json keeps status new while T1 to T3 are [x]); (3) `measure/generated/status.md: stale generated fact` (status.md:26 shows 0/3 against 3 complete). `node measure/tools/generate.mjs --check` also exits 1 on the same stale fact. The closeout standard requires doctor exit 0. The phase-acceptance F6 closeout action (run generate.sh) fixes only error 3; errors 1 and 2 need a track index.md and a status flip. Owner: orchestrator (record bookkeeping only; the owner of a plan.md finding is the user or a build session). Action: create measure/tracks/chore_dependency_refresh_20261121/index.md like the index.md of the other active tracks, set metadata.json status to a value consistent with three complete tasks (and update the plan Status: line), run ./measure/generate.sh, commit, then re-run final acceptance. No implementation, test, or gate change is needed.
nonblocking_findings: FA-2 [Nit] final-acceptance (carried from phase acceptance F1): `prettier --check .` flags the untracked reviewer JSON result files under measure/runs/chore_dependency_refresh_20261121/ because prettier expands their one-line ratings objects. At the audited HEAD none of them is tracked, so AC3 holds. Owner: orchestrator. Action: run `node_modules/.bin/prettier --write` on the reviewer result files before committing them. The two final-acceptance artifacts are written prettier-clean.

FA-3 [Nit] final-acceptance (carried from phase acceptance F2 to F5, closeout text edits): plan.md:38 quotes scripts/audit-gate.mjs lines 18 and 91, but TIMEOUT_MS sits at line 21 and is used at line 192; the plan has no record line for Review B F12 (closed by the 4 MiB test) and F13 (open Nit) or for adversarial commit 7b7464a9, and the targeted count is now 30 of 30; jr-green-199189d9.log:2 and jr-green-d0f755c8.log:2 say `all gates pass` next to tsc exit 2; measure/tech-debt.md TD-38 names only line 587 while the two TS2554 errors sit at lines 195 and 587. These record edits can ride the same bookkeeping commit as FA-1. Owner: orchestrator at closeout.

FA-4 [Nit] final-acceptance (deviation note): PROJECT_LINT, PROJECT_CHECKS, and PROJECT_TESTS were unset in this role's environment. The orchestrator brief supplied the configured gates instead: the AC3 subset rule (prettier --check ., tsc --noEmit, vitest run, vite build through heavy-run.sh). All four ran fresh at the audited HEAD 5d74968c in phase acceptance (revision-bound: its role_base_sha and audited_head_sha equal current HEAD, and no commit followed), and the fresh spot-checks of this role confirm the state, so gate coverage holds through that evidence. The mechanical role-gate still fails on the unset values, so the orchestrator must export the three variables for the re-run of this role after the FA-1 fix.
